data.original_title: Deep Cover in a major port city
data.overview: In the early 2000s, a covert operative enters a major port city's criminal underworld under a false identity. To dismantle a violent alliance from within, he must earn the trust of men who would kill him if they learned his real mission.
data.tagline: Trust is the most dangerous disguise.
data.title: Deep Cover in a major port city
